title: Word Search II
description: Given an `m x n` board of characters and a list of strings `words`, return all words that can be formed on the board. Output the matching words in alphabetical order separated by space.
input_format: First line contains `m`, `n`, and `k` (words). Following `m` lines contain board. Next line contains `k` words.
output_format: Space-separated matching words in alphabetical order.

sample_tests.input:
4 4 4
o a a n
e t a e
i h k r
i f l v
oath pea eat rain
sample_tests.explanation: Only 'eat' and 'oath' exist on the board.

hidden_tests.input:
2 2 2
a b
a a
a aba

hints: Build a Trie containing all dictionary words.
Traverse the board with DFS, pruning paths that do not match any Trie prefix.
Mark visited cells in-place to avoid duplicate visits during recursion.
